The PKGBUILD contains no malicious top-level code, and the package() function only extracts and installs files. The disagreement was solely due to a transient API error in one model when processing the .SRCINFO metadata file.
disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' because it encountered an HTTP 400 API error while auditing the .SRCINFO file. The deepseek model successfully audited both files and correctly returned 'safe'.

learnings: Transient API errors when auditing non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force the entire package verdict to 'inconclusive' if the executable packaging files (PKGBUILD) are safely audited. The tool should handle such errors gracefully without failing the whole audit.
